decisions.statement: The GPU runtime class gives no device capability the rig needs.
Creating the virtual keyboard needs the uinput device.
An unprivileged container's device cgroup denies opening an event node.
A denied event node leaves the evdev driver unable to bind the device.
A denied event node leaves the evdev driver unable to grab the device.
The X server opens a virtual terminal under the dummy driver.
The pod mounts the host's /dev/input live.
Privilege without that mount leaves the rig failing before a verdict is reached.
A container's own /dev is filled once at startup and never again.
The node the rig makes after startup is the only node the rig reads.
Card access comes from the runtime class and the resource request.
Privilege gives the pod no card access.
The rig is scheduled onto the one node in its workload class.
The rig runs no copies until a run is wanted.
The Wine prefix is kept on the node's disk.
A fresh Wine prefix creates a new machine identity against the game account.

definition: what runs the Elder Scrolls Online client with nobody at a keyboard
